name: opening-impulse-engineering-v1
source: Existing Databento GLBX.MDP3 MNQ.v.0 ohlcv-1m export; continuous series, not an executable contract
strategy: At completion of the 09:44 New York minute, compare its close with the 09:30 open. Buy if higher, sell if lower, skip if equal. Require all 15 consecutive opening minutes. Submit at most one entry per day. Bracket stop is 80 ticks from each actual simulated entry fill. At completion of the 10:14 minute, submit a reduce-only time exit for remaining inventory. No target or trailing stop.
execution: Market orders fill at the first positive-volume minute open at least latency_bars full minutes after submission, plus adverse slippage. Unfilled entry quantity expires after three additional minutes. Protective stops may fill on the entry minute; when crossed, use the worse of the stop and the opening price, then adverse slippage. No queue or tick-path claim. Stops operate inside the simulator during worker disconnects.
economic_hurdle: No alpha verdict permitted. Report gross/net accounting and execution stress only; a positive replay is not evidence of a tradable edge.
stopping_rule: Complete only the registered five-session engineering window. Retain all scenarios including failures; no parameter search, additional dates or evaluation holdout. Missing opening minutes suppress that day's entry. No overnight carry is acceptable at the end of the test.
limits: Fees are declared test assumptions, not a broker quote. Source export lacks individual contract mapping and quotes. This lab cannot route to an external broker and cannot certify execution realism, live readiness or profitability. A separate registered forward run, approved streaming data access and complete broker adapter remain required.
